_doc: RE-backend auto-launch config read by autolaunch.py. Maps each RE MCP bridge (mcp__<key>__*) to the backend port(s) its calls forward to, and how to cold-start it on-demand via the re-harness (re_launch.py). The PreToolUse hook fires ONLY when one of these MCP tools is invoked (never at session start), probes the backend port(s), and if DOWN cold-starts ONLY that one backend. RAM-conscious: on-demand, single-backend, idempotent (re_launch probes-if-up first), prefers an already-running GUI/headless instance (never duplicates), and refuses to launch when free RAM is below min_free_ram_mb (the user just hit an OOM). The live GUI IDA on :13337 is a 'prefer' port: if it is up the hook no-ops and the headless server is never started.

ida-pro-mcp.why: IDA Pro decompiler. GUI plugin on :13337 is PREFERRED (interactive) and never duplicated; headless idalib_server on :8745 is cold-started only when both are down.

ghidra-mcp.why: GhidraMCP headless server on :8089 (true no-GUI; the ghidra-mcp stdio bridge already targets this port).

binary-ninja-mcp.manual_hint: Binary Ninja cannot run headless on a Personal license, so this backend is NOT auto-launched. Open the Binary Ninja GUI, load the target binary, and start the BN MCP server plugin on :9009 (Plugins menu), then retry.
binary-ninja-mcp.why: Binary Ninja MCP server (GUI plugin on :9009). No headless mode under a Personal license.
